summary: Map supplier exposure, prioritize disruption risks and create mitigation records. Explore this five-day course and build practical supply-chain risk capability.
lede: Supply chain risk management helps procurement, logistics and operations practitioners map dependencies and assess disruption exposure. This foundation course develops skills in creating supply network maps and supplier risk profiles, prioritizing risks by likelihood and impact, and planning mitigation with clear ownership. It also covers monitoring indicators and escalation updates, using ISO 31000:2018 to structure risk assessment and treatment.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for practitioners who identify supply-chain exposures, coordinate supplier mitigations or prepare for disruption. It suits you if your work involves supplier information, network dependencies, risk ownership or continuity planning.
prerequisites: A working familiarity with supply-chain, procurement, logistics or operational processes is recommended. Coding is not required; exercises use risk records, network maps and spreadsheet-based tracking.
